text: The good thing about science is that it's true whether or not you believe in it.
author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

archive.text: To speak gratitude is courteous and pleasant, to enact gratitude is generous and noble, but to live gratitude is to touch Heaven.

archive.text: The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.

archive.text: The creation of something new is not accomplished by the intellect but by the play instinct.

archive.text: Spread love everywhere you go. Let no one ever come to you without leaving happier.
archive.author: Mother Teresa

archive.text: Fame usually comes to those who are thinking about something else.
archive.author: Holmes

archive.text: Write your plans in pencil and give God the eraser.
archive.author: Paulo Coelho

archive.text: Don't limit a child to your own learning, for he was born in another time.
archive.author: Rabindranath Tagore
